name: agent-pipeline
description: One command from feature request to mergeable PR: stack detection, planning, property discovery, design debate, tests-first with one model plus held-out tests, implementation with another (barred from editing tests or switching checks off), mutation check, running-system evaluation, verified independent and red-team review, a PR in the repo's own format, then CI and review-bot follow-through until it's mergeable. Resumable.
